scope: complete 10k S4 validation reused after research design; calibration/test frozen
design_scope: Seed42 comparison of five initializations. Corrected train-inner common recipes at 1k/10k, stage145 validation-NLL recipe at 100k. Frozen full/global use the same temporary 100k feature bank and exact nested label rows; scaler fitted only on labeled fit rows, fixed C=1, FP64 Newton-CG and measured gradient <=1e-6. Partial channel Rel uses additional simulated semantic supervision. Full fine-tuning versus frozen readout compares complete protocols. Pointwise physical-block intervals condition on these weights and the reused validation. The five 100k frozen fits use gated FP64 device gradient/Hessian products on the identical convex objective with independent CPU stationarity certificates. The 1k/10k CPU fits are unchanged.
